title: Orbit and Static
author: Paloma Almeida
blurb: Zephyrine Underhill, a memory-smuggler running contraband past orbital customs, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
